geometries.method: Midpoint of the 130°E mooring array from 8.5°N to 17.5°N; multiple subsurface jets, not one measured centerline.
geometries.positional_uncertainty: not quantified; no observed current core or path

length_assessments.illustration_limit: Drawn map-arrow span, not a physical current length or lower bound
length_assessments.scope: The 130°E mooring array measures eastward subsurface jets between 8.5°N and 17.5°N, with 5.1 Sv mean positive transport to 900 m under the study definition. This cross-section is not a path length.
